time_slice.description: An Astral sword strike lowers Crono's maximum HP for the battle.
time_slice.flavor: He adjusts his grip below the crack.

astral_smear_dash.description: Crono spends maximum HP to dash through enemies in a line, clearing VHS Fog along his path.
astral_smear_dash.flavor: The scarf arrives after the sword.

astral_slash.description: Sweeps an Astral cone at the cost of maximum HP, leaving a trail that slows enemies crossing it.
astral_slash.flavor: His wrist shakes only after the blade stops.

time_debt_seal.description: Lowers Crono's maximum HP until camp to refund Sera's last solidity cost or prevent her impending Causal Collapse.
time_debt_seal.flavor: He closes his hand around the flicker.

bekkler_guilt.description: Crono spends maximum HP to take reduced hits meant for nearby allies and earn BP from the redirected attacks.
bekkler_guilt.flavor: He sets his feet where the others were standing.

astral_field.description: An Astral pulse costs Crono maximum HP, clears nearby Grief-Resonance and VHS Fog, and reduces Ruin damage to allies inside.
astral_field.flavor: He holds his palm out until the room stops trembling.

luminaire.description: Spends Crono's maximum HP to flood a wide circle with repeated Astral and Light strikes.
luminaire.flavor: Light escapes beneath his buckles. He leaves them fastened.

unborrowed_time.description: Strains Crono to strike an enemy with his Time Egg core, adding damage based on its remaining HP.

null_erasure.description: Sacrifices maximum HP until camp for a piercing Null strike that Breaks Null-weak targets and strips plates from others.
null_erasure.flavor: He draws the sword back through a missing color.

null_crono.description: At the cost of Crono's maximum HP, strips tags, resistances and buffs in a circle, including allies, and gives weaknessless targets a temporary false weakness.
null_crono.flavor: His thumb follows the crease the teacher left.

rewind.description: Spends Sera's solidity to restore an ally or enemy's HP, gauge, position and recent statuses to their last turn start.
rewind.flavor: Sorry. Let me put that before it hurt.

hold.description: Spends Sera's solidity to keep a Broken enemy locked in Break for longer.
hold.flavor: Your turn can wait. Mine already did.

tachyon_needle.description: Fires Tachyon needles down a narrow line, pushing enemy gauges back and shaving extra plates from Magnetized targets.
tachyon_needle.flavor: You keep standing where I was going to miss.

fall_break.description: Reduces an ally's next Time Debt cost, including Crono's strain, Sera's solidity or Krona's Corruption.
fall_break.flavor: Papa, let me catch this end.

borrowed_future.description: Spends Sera's solidity and pulls allied gauges backward to give the ally closest to acting a free repeat of their last action.

borrowed_future_true.description: Spends solidity and pulls allied gauges backward to duplicate the nearest-ready ally's action, extending its Breaks after Sera's voluntary phase-out.
borrowed_future_true.flavor: Save my place. I'm choosing where to come back.

rewind_reel.description: Spends Sera's solidity to rewind enemy positions, telegraphs and gauges across the battlefield without rewinding allies.

slip_backtrack.description: Spends solidity to rewind Sera's own HP, gauge and position.
slip_backtrack.flavor: I left something behind. Mostly me.

hz_static_pure.description: Pulses HZ and Tachyon through a circle, healing allies inside as the hits land.
hz_static_pure.flavor: He gave me the quiet bit. Listen.

null_sera.description: Spends Sera's solidity to strip tags, resistances and buffs in a circle, including allies, and give weaknessless targets a temporary false weakness.
null_sera.flavor: Master, does the blank have to include us?

atropos_ribbon.description: Spends Sera's solidity to cut Vaelos's tether along a fate line and waive upcoming party Time Debt costs, unless the Prometheus Core was burned selfishly.
atropos_ribbon.flavor: You don't get to tie a knot in my name.

hover_rewind_hp.description: From Hover Support, Sera spends solidity to return an ally's HP to its last turn-start value.
hover_rewind_hp.flavor: Still here, Papa. Just a little to the side.

hover_fast_forward.description: From Hover Support, Sera spends solidity to advance an ally's gauge.
hover_fast_forward.flavor: Go on. I'll argue with the clock.

teppo_ash_cut.description: Slashes a broad cone with Ruin, leaving ink that damages enemies standing in it.
teppo_ash_cut.flavor: Stay clear of brush. Still wet.

ruin_purge.description: Blasts a circle with Ruin, strips enemy buffs and leaves an Ash Field that slows enemies and wears away temporary plates.

cinnabar_flare.description: Sweeps Ruin and Fire through a cone, igniting oil and carrying the flames along oil seams.

shoguns_command.description: Redirects some incoming party damage onto Krona and, if she survives, lets allies' next hits ignore defense.

oil_drinker.description: Heals the party from Krona's gourd while increasing her Corruption.
oil_drinker.flavor: Bad medicine. Better than empty hands.

crimson_seppuku.description: Leaves Krona near death and raises Corruption to unleash a Ruin wave, reduce enemy healing, scatter Ash Fields and trigger her gourd.
crimson_seppuku.flavor: Not funeral yet. Keep gourd close.

cobalt_nodachi.description: After a wind-up, cuts a long Ruin line through enemies and clears Ash Fields.

gramophone_resonance.description: Blasts enemies in a cone with Ferro sound, hitting metal harder and delaying metallic enemies' next actions.
gramophone_resonance.flavor: That rattle is not part of the recording.

ferro_graviton.description: Pulls enemies into a circle of Ferro shards and Magnetizes them.
ferro_graviton.flavor: Lucca, may I use your calculations?

mercury_pulse.description: Spends Cassia's recharging mercury orb to pulse nearby enemies, reveal their weaknesses, slow them and bind them magnetically.
mercury_pulse.flavor: The scan found a seam. The seam found me looking.

wire_loom_mend.description: Mends an ally's HP and battle-lost maximum HP, repairing Crono's integrity or clearing art-curse hazards from other copies.
wire_loom_mend.flavor: May I touch the wrist, Crono?

sound_ring.description: Sends a Ferro sound wave around Cassia and leaves a lingering ring that improves amber shard drops.
sound_ring.flavor: Audio log: Stop calling it feedback. It's answering.

gatling_arm.description: Fires a piercing barrage from Cassia's bipedal arm, Magnetizing targets with the final hit.
gatling_arm.flavor: Recoil recorded. I would like my balance back.

prometheus_overload.description: Detonates a burning Ferro nova that hurts nearby allies and delays Cassia's next turn, marking the Core selfishly burned without Lucca's consent.
prometheus_overload.flavor: Lucca, I need your answer before the light.

mycelia_tether.description: Spends Shared orbs on tethers that share allied damage and bloom into healing when snapped by damage, without shaving plates while building.
mycelia_tether.flavor: Roots do not ask which branch deserves the rain.

photosynthetic_burst.description: Bursts through a circle, spending Spore Tags and Sunlight Stacks to restore tethered allies' HP and MP while Xyloph is rooted.
photosynthetic_burst.flavor: Stand still, little rot. Your green is coming in.

dew_lance.description: Sends a piercing Mycelia and Water lance through enemies and extinguishes oil fires.
dew_lance.flavor: Even the thirsty have sharp edges.

core_lattice.description: Lattices Crono in his galaxy state, reducing his Astral strain costs and raising his defense.
core_lattice.flavor: A trellis need not understand the stars.

divinity_field.description: Covers the arena with a field that grows allied shields, eases Ruin, silences enemies on Break and counters Vaelos's Gravity.
divinity_field.flavor: Rest your weight here. The ground has roots.

reptite_crown.description: Strikes a circle with Mycelia petals and grows a canopy that keeps supplying Sunlight Stacks for the battle.

lily_lancets.description: Drives glass lancets through a line, shaving extra plates when their refracted colors match the target's shield.
lily_lancets.flavor: Entry 4-31: I regret the necessity of edges.

cathedral_ray.description: Sends a piercing Vitreous ray through enemies, taking on the elemental tag of a colored pane it crosses.
cathedral_ray.flavor: Entry 4-32: I am less certain in amber.

vitreous_prism.description: Spends Light Stacks on extra Vitreous beams in a split cone, leaving a caustic floor.
vitreous_prism.flavor: The cat steps out of his chest onto the light.

prism_refraction.description: Fires a cone of Vitreous prisms without spending Light Stacks, with exceptional damage against the Glass Matriarch.
prism_refraction.flavor: Entry 4-33: Anger is not an archival error.

baptistery.description: Splashes a circle with Vitreous and Water damage while restoring HP to allies inside.
baptistery.flavor: He lowers the lance; the cat paws at the thaw.

rose_window.description: When sufficiently Boosted, bursts around Vesper and adds Vitreous and extra angled hits to party attacks.
rose_window.flavor: Entry 4-34: I can bear to see her now.

fractured_lens.description: Fills Vesper's Light Stacks by reducing him to critical HP and leaving him Fragile.
fractured_lens.flavor: The open library shines through his lowered hands.

prism_guard.description: Reduces incoming damage until Vesper's next turn and stores hits as Light Stacks, gaining more while the cat overlaps him.
prism_guard.flavor: Entry 4-35: I am grateful she stayed.

sleight_of_arm.description: Strikes an enemy at extended reach and steals BP for the party, taking a consumable if BP is unavailable.
sleight_of_arm.flavor: CHECK YOUR POCKETS! NO, THE POCKETS I LEFT YOU!

guile_feint.description: Feints at an enemy, steals BP and reveals who the target will attack next.
guile_feint.flavor: AND NOW, A PEEK AT THE GUEST LIST!

guile_elastic.description: Strikes and steals BP while leaving a taunting clone to draw enemy attacks.

swap_face.description: Strikes an enemy and makes its attacks liable to hit its own allies.
swap_face.flavor: TRY THE SMILE! IT ITCHES LESS AFTER A WHILE!

prop_hammer.description: Pounds an enemy with a blunt prop hammer, shaving extra plates from inflated or rubber targets.

balloon_escape.description: Lets Glenn dodge by flattening, briefly ignore Fire and block the next attempt to steal party BP.
balloon_escape.flavor: PLEASE DON'T FOLD THE PERFORMER AFTER USE!

honest_laugh.description: Leaves Glenn near death and Fragile to gain BP and make an ally's next hit count as honest Guile.
honest_laugh.flavor: No trick in this hand. Don't make me prove it again.

prop_cannon.description: Fires a heavy Blunt, Fire and Guile blast through enemies in a line.
prop_cannon.flavor: FOR OUR FINAL ACT, PLEASE REMAIN VERY FAR AWAY!

the_last_joke.description: Consumes the party's BP to force Vaelos to laugh, letting subsequent hits bypass his shields and defense.
the_last_joke.flavor: Even god's got gap in his teeth.

hz_static.description: Rattles enemies in a circle with HZ hits and Jams their magic casting.
hz_static.flavor: He tilts the noisy screen away from Sera.

hz_white_noise.description: Batters a circle with white noise while temporarily hiding enemy weakness information from the party.
hz_white_noise.flavor: Snow fills the goggles. His taped fingers keep their grip.

56k_prayer.description: Strikes an enemy with HZ and Null, gaining damage from its debuffs and weakening Vaelos's defense when it hits him.
56k_prayer.flavor: The tubes brighten against his throat. His shoulders lock.

red_bike_ghost.description: Dashes through enemies in a fiery line, slowing their gauges and actions and leaving oil fire that becomes an Ash Field.
red_bike_ghost.flavor: His yellow coat trails above the red wheels.

akira_in_utero.description: Makes enemies across the battlefield temporarily weak to HZ without dealing damage and exposes Vaelos's true voice.
akira_in_utero.flavor: He unfastens the coat. Cyan light spills over his taped feet.

tune.description: Freely changes Static's frequency, ending VHS Blind and selecting the tags and support effects carried by his tuning.
tune.flavor: A steady picture. A small nod.

null_omega.description: Strips tags, resistances and buffs from everyone in a circle, including allies, and grants weaknessless targets a temporary false weakness.
null_omega.flavor: The paper opens where his face ought to answer.

miura_fold.description: Links enemy HP in a temporary fold, returning the pool's damage as true damage when it releases.
miura_fold.flavor: A crease runs through the space between them.

lotus_reverse.description: Unfolds an ally's recent past to reverse a fresh KO, refund spent MP and cleanse statuses, leaving a decoy to draw an attack.
lotus_reverse.flavor: He smooths the crushed paper with the back of his hand.

gold_leaf_severance.description: Spends Gold Leaf stacks to make party hits deal true damage across the battlefield and deny Vaelos his next action.
gold_leaf_severance.flavor: The chime stops. Its gold keeps falling.

kintsugi_mend.description: Restores an ally's HP and lost maximum HP, mending Crono's integrity when used on him.
kintsugi_mend.flavor: Papa, I can fill it without eating it.

porcelain_memory.description: Strikes an enemy and adds the weakness tag Vaelos is holding.
porcelain_memory.flavor: I kept the shape. I didn't keep you.

null_spoon_hold.description: Places a learned weakness on an enemy so allied hits can exploit it for damage and shield shaving.
null_spoon_hold.flavor: The spoon stays level. I said so.

light_bolt.description: Fires Light-tagged crossbow bolts at an enemy, opening plates keyed to Light.
light_bolt.flavor: A crown doesn't make my hands ornamental.

ward.description: Heals an ally and reduces the damage of their next incoming hit.
ward.flavor: You can be needed and still need help.

vitreous_arrow.description: Shoots an enemy with Vitreous glass bolts.
vitreous_arrow.flavor: I asked for arrows, not another person to stand in front.

eclipse_x_strike.description: Crono and Krona cross Astral and Ruin strikes, stripping buffs and plates at the crossing while straining Crono.

overclocked_short_circuit.description: Sends an Astral, Ruin and Volt arc through metal, stopping at non-metal and shaving extra plates from Magnetized targets.

solar_railgun.description: Strains Crono to fire him through a line of enemies, leaving overlapping watercolour and amber fields when the attack Breaks a target.
solar_railgun.flavor: Crono, may I count your nod as launch permission?

reinforced_guard.description: Takes Battle Strain now to reinforce Crono against Time Debt from upcoming gate jumps.
reinforced_guard.flavor: Audio log: The seam isn't a handle. Stop carrying him by it.

iron_maiden_scroll.description: Closes a Ruin and Ferro cage on enemies, strengthening ash and amber damage lingering inside.
iron_maiden_scroll.flavor: Latch holds. Stand clear of hinges.

time_mines.description: Spends Sera's solidity to plant mercury mines at enemies' last turn-start positions, detonating when they return or are Rewound there.
time_mines.flavor: Cassia, mark where they looked pleased with themselves.

fake_family_photo.description: Sera spends solidity to heal Crono in his galaxy state and ease his Battle Strain.
fake_family_photo.flavor: Papa, stop trying to hide behind me. I'm transparent.

solar_winds.description: Sends Astral wind through a broad cone, strengthened by Sunlight Stacks, while taking Battle Strain from Crono.
solar_winds.flavor: Your scarf is learning the weather, little rot.

triangulation.description: Strains Crono to dash along an active tether, land a guaranteed critical hit and extend Break.
triangulation.flavor: The vine bends beneath his foot and keeps its hold.

spore_rail.description: Shreds an active tether into piercing shrapnel, releases stored shared damage as nearby healing and grows a walkable vine rail.
spore_rail.flavor: Prune here. The hurt has already grown roots.

mycelia_time_lapse.description: Speeds nearby spore ticks and extends Break without shaving plates, then refunds Sera's solidity cost.
mycelia_time_lapse.flavor: She calls this patient gardening. I'm being very patient, quickly.

vitreous_refraction.description: Spends Sera's solidity to split Vitreous and Tachyon light into a fan of beams, strengthened when they pass through a tether.
vitreous_refraction.flavor: Vesper, your cat keeps pouncing on my elbows.

refraction_needle.description: Spends Sera's solidity to split piercing Tachyon and Vitreous needles along branching lines, heavily shaving targets weak to their tags.
refraction_needle.flavor: The cat watches the needles. Vesper watches the cat's reflection.

chrono_prism.description: Requires Crono's visible cracks and strains him to pause time for placement of a shield-shaving Astral, Vitreous and Tachyon circle.
chrono_prism.flavor: The cat rests a shadow-paw against the exposed wrist.

prismlight_salvo.description: Fires a piercing Vitreous and Ferro rail of refracted shards aimed by the cat.
prismlight_salvo.flavor: The cat's corrections are not in my manual. I am keeping them.

ash_graveyard.description: Strikes a circle with Ruin and Vitreous light, turning ash beneath it into a caustic floor that heals allies.
ash_graveyard.flavor: Something grows here. Watch where you step.

bloom_crown.description: Strikes around the casters and grows a canopy whose light heals allies and supplies Sunlight Stacks.
bloom_crown.flavor: Glass, you make a very peculiar leaf.

masque_feint.description: Strikes an enemy, steals a buff and catches its next attack in a glass mask to reflect it.
masque_feint.flavor: A FACE SO FINE YOU CAN SEE YOUR MISTAKES IN IT!

guilt_halo.description: Strikes around Crono, steals BP on a Break and briefly reduces his maximum-HP costs.
guilt_halo.flavor: Lean here. Painted shoulder's still shoulder.

honest_stage.description: Requires Crono's visible cracks to cut a piercing Astral, Guile and Vitreous line through enemies and threads, shaving extra plates.

ashen_bash.description: Combines Crono's sword with Glenn's blunt prop blows against an enemy, at a Battle Strain cost to Crono.
ashen_bash.flavor: PLEASE ADMIRE THE SWORD WHILE I FIND MY HAMMER!

mercy_leap.description: Flings Sera through a line of enemies to reposition her, or uses Vesper's refracted leap to heal the party and clear Grief-Resonance.
mercy_leap.flavor: MIND THE LANDING! THE ARM'S STILL ATTACHED TO ME!

ruin_elastic.description: Hits an enemy with stretched Ruin ink and leaves a decoy to draw its next action.

omega_annihilation.description: Collapses a circle to cancel a boss ultimate and reset its gauge, with repeated use costing Sera extra solidity.
omega_annihilation.flavor: Sera counts him in with her fingers. He nods.

tachyon_static.description: Spends Sera's solidity on a Tachyon and HZ line attack that raises caster evasion but hides the boss's next phase weaknesses.
tachyon_static.flavor: Her ghosts lean into the snow; his coat stays bright.

anachronism_glass.description: Strikes a circle with Vitreous and HZ, granting allies inside a Glass Ward against incoming hits.
anachronism_glass.flavor: Static braces the new pane. The cat leaves a pawprint of light.

graviton_whiteout.description: Bombards a circle with magnetic HZ and Ferro, temporarily preventing enemy shield regeneration and rebuilding.
graviton_whiteout.flavor: His goggles and her gramophone settle on the same tremor.

solar_railgun_static.description: Strains Crono to launch an Astral, HZ and Fire line attack, shaving extra plates when Static has tuned CARRION on the target.
solar_railgun_static.flavor: Static straightens the antenna. Crono lowers his shoulder.

ferro_null.description: Strains Crono to pierce enemies with Ferro and Null, shaving plates regardless of weakness and increasing Dark affinity.
ferro_null.flavor: The recording continues. I will not label this an accident.

empress_cannon.description: Fires a piercing Ruin and Ferro gun barrage from bipedal Cassia, increasing Dark affinity with use.

origami_requiem.description: Strains Crono to dash through a fold line with Sera or Omega-Spekkio, leaving a gold field that gradually thaws Ruin.
origami_requiem.flavor: Paint gathers in the crease; a crane lifts clear of it.

time_debt_paid.description: Spends Sera's solidity and Crono's integrity to heal the party and remove Glaze Erosion, with Light granting automatic revival.
time_debt_paid.flavor: Papa, leave the pieces where I can reach them.

porcelain_promise.description: Combines Crono's blade with Marle's Light bolts in a line, making Crono's next Astral technique cost no strain.
porcelain_promise.flavor: You don't have to be warm for me to hold you.

porcelain_promise_child.description: Heals allies around Crono and Vaelos, eases Crono's Battle Strain and mends his integrity.
porcelain_promise_child.flavor: Your hand fits, Papa. You can stop checking.

ashtear_paradox.description: Strains Crono to detonate an Astral, Ferro and Ruin singularity, strengthened by his galaxy state and granting Reinforced through high Cassia Synergy.
ashtear_paradox.flavor: Audio log: I asked for cooperation, not a smaller universe.

ashtear_paradox_family.description: Costs Crono Battle Strain and Sera solidity to unleash an Astral, Ferro and Tachyon volley, with high Cassia Synergy granting Reinforced.
ashtear_paradox_family.flavor: The gramophone skips; Sera catches the missing beat.

first_light_that_never_was.description: Strains Crono to release a wide Genesis blast that heals the party for the damage it deals.
first_light_that_never_was.flavor: A dawn with no wound in its sky.

first_light_fragment_i.description: Releases a weaker Genesis blast with Cassia, straining Crono and healing the party for damage dealt.
first_light_fragment_i.flavor: The leaves open before the gramophone finds the sunrise.

chrono_laugh.description: Strikes around the casters, splits shared shields into separate shields, Breaks the smallest and heals the party at the cost of strain and solidity.
chrono_laugh.flavor: Glenn waits. Sera laughs before the painted smile returns.

delta_storm.description: Strikes a triangular area with Astral, Ruin and Guile, gaining damage when the casters are near death and straining Crono.
delta_storm.flavor: A phantom hand takes its place beside the empty sleeve.

carnival_of_souls.description: Strikes around Glenn's glass-lit tent and adds BP that can temporarily exceed the party's cap.
carnival_of_souls.flavor: ROOM UNDER THE BIG TOP! EVEN FOR THE ONES WHO STOPPED CLAPPING!

washi_hollow_rebirth.description: Spends Crono's maximum HP to fully heal the party and strip plates from enemies caught in a sufficiently Boosted Venn overlap.
washi_hollow_rebirth.flavor: Light reaches the floor through seams nobody covers.

omega_triple.description: Strikes a wide circle, erasing even allied resistances there and granting the party Null Shield for the battle at a solidity cost to Sera.
omega_triple.flavor: Static catches the falling paper before it touches her scarf.

family_porcelain.description: With sufficient Light, costs strain and solidity to mend Crono's integrity and reinforce the party against Time Debt from upcoming gate jumps.
family_porcelain.flavor: Papa, Little Sister left room for my hand.

fake_family_photo_real.description: Heals allies in a circle, eases Crono's Battle Strain and reinforces the party for its next gate jump without requiring his galaxy state.
fake_family_photo_real.flavor: This time, nobody has to stand inside anybody else.

first_light_child.description: Strikes around the family, splits shared shields or Mycelia pools into individual shields, Breaks emptied shields and heals the party for damage dealt.
first_light_child.flavor: The blocks fall into open hands instead of onto the floor.

promise_across_rust.description: Mends Crono's integrity and plants a permanent garden that reduces Glaze Erosion, paid for with strain, solidity and party BP.
promise_across_rust.flavor: [CARE CONTINUES. RUST IS NOT A STOP COMMAND.]
